description: Minimal flow telemetry derived only from packets observed in one directional 5-tuple. A capture may contain multiple directions; this contract does not attest to one-way capture provenance.

fields.src: Source IP address from each observed packet.
fields.dst: Destination IP address from each observed packet.
fields.protocol: TCP or UDP as decoded from each observed packet.
fields.src_port: Source transport port from each observed packet.
fields.dst_port: Destination transport port from each observed packet.
fields.observed_packets: Number of observed packets in this directional 5-tuple and inactivity window.
fields.observed_bytes: Sum of captured Ethernet frame lengths, including the Ethernet header.
fields.observed_duration_ms: Maximum observed packet timestamp minus minimum observed packet timestamp for this directional 5-tuple and inactivity window.

limitations: Reverse-direction packets are grouped separately and are never added to the same directional flow accumulator.
A PCAP or PCAPNG file is not a trusted sensor. direction_validation.status must remain unverified.
Fragmented IP packets, non-TCP/UDP traffic, unsupported link types, and unsupported capture layouts are not used for flow generation.
This basic telemetry schema is not the trained PortScan/DDoS feature schema and cannot be fed directly to those models without a separately validated feature-conversion stage.
